name: himalaya-skills
description: Read, search, organize and compose email from the terminal via the himalaya CLI (IMAP/SMTP).

plugins.name: himalaya-skills
plugins.description: Drive himalaya v2 (CLI email client over IMAP/SMTP/JMAP/Gmail REST/MS Graph): list/search/read/move/flag, attachments, flag composer, MML via the standalone mml tool, raw IMAP/SMTP passthrough. Includes account setup for Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Yahoo and OAuth2, a v1→v2 migration table — and a Yahoo throttling warning.
